text:
iris (Design): dropping a compact mock for the Alerting config panel. Main changes: inline threshold editor, channel stack with drag handles + keyboard reorder modal, and a small 'Example alert' preview per-channel. Thoughts on copy & flows?

omar (Product): looks neat. can we rename 'threshold' label to 'Trigger threshold' and add a tooltip: 'When to open an incident'? makes it clearer to PMs.

ben (Eng): implementation comment: avoid real-time sample rendering for every channel on load. plan: one summary endpoint for tiles and fetch example payloads on demand. also debounce reorder saves.

noor (A11y): a11y checklist: 1) keyboard-only reorder modal with instructions (Space to pick, Arrows to move, Enter to drop), 2) aria-live announce after reorder, 3) preview region must be reachable without mouse.

iris (Design): agreed. For the channel stack I want a small 'Lock order' button (instead of pin) that persists per-project. Locked channels float to top and get a lock icon.

omar (Product): UX note: show a tiny divider 'Manual order' above locked channels and add an 'Auto-sorted' badge for the rest. Also show who last updated order in a tooltip.

ben (Eng): backend sketch: add field locked:boolean + order:int in subscription config. endpoint: PUT /projects/:id/notify-config {channels:[{id,order,locked}]}. We'll also surface a minimal tile summary: [{channel_id, freq_score, worst_sev, last_snippet}].

noor (A11y): visual: do not rely on color only. add icon overlays for severity and patterned fills for critical bars. focus ring must meet 3:1 contrast at minimum and ideally AA. Announce summary like: 'Slack-ops: high frequency, recent critical' when preview opens.

iris (Design): copy tweak: replace 'Notification preview' with 'Example alert' and show a one-line subject + recipient list. Also change 'SLO breach window' -> 'Evaluation window' with presets 1h / 24h (default) / 7d.

omar (Product): good. Also add a small 'Undo' toast after order changes: 'Channel order updated — Undo'. Helps with accidental edits.

ben (Eng): concurrency note: latest-write-wins for order changes. We'll add a warning toast if a newer write is detected and give option to reload.

iris (Design): I'll iterate mocks to include: lock-first group with divider, auto badge, keyboard reorder modal copy, patterned severity overlays, and the 'Example alert' content. Posting GIF in follow-up.

design-bot: Reminder: design review scheduled tomorrow 10:30 AM PT (topic: alerting config updates).

omar (Product): thanks all  please flag blockers by EOD so we can scope for next sprint.
